reference.title: AT+MHTTPREQUEST Send HTTP Request
reference.shortdesc: This command is used to send HTTP request.

row.entry: If succeed: +MHTTPREQUEST: (list of supported <httpid>s),(list of supported <method>s),(list of supported <length>s), OK If fail: +CME ERROR: <err>

If succeed:
<length> and <path> are not configured. Send data by CTRL+Z, and cancel sending by ESC: >(input data) OK <length> is configured while <path> is not. Send data when input data reaches the specified length or timeout is reached: >(input data) OK All parameters set: OK If fail: +CME ERROR: <err>

In standard mode, configure content data before sending request. In Chunked mode, send request before configuring content data. Use single-threaded downloads when downloading data to file system via AT+MHTTPREQUEST command.
<method>Request type. ML307G: DELETE requested response shall not include configured content data.

<length>Data input length 0-4096. In data mode, setting to 0 is not permitted. When directly inputting data in command mode: If set to 0, no length validation is performed on the input data; If set >0, the system will validate the input data length. (For ASCII and escaped string input modes: The system shall validate whether the actual input string length in the command matches the specified length. For HEX string input mode: The system shall verify the actual input string length equals twice the specified length.)
MN327: In direct command input mode, the maximum length of a single command is 2048 characters; exceeding this limit will result in an error.
ML302S/ML307S/ML302A/ML305A/ML307A/ML307G/ML305M/ML307R/ML307B/ML307C/ML307M/ML307H/ML307N/MR380R/MR380M: In data mode, this can be set to 0. ML305U: In data mode, setting to 0 is permitted. The parameter defaults to 0 when the parameter is omitted.

<path>Requested url path. The <input_format> parameter configured via AT+MHTTPCFG="encoding" shall only apply to direct command input mode (where <path> is explicit included in AT commands), and shall not affect data mode input (which uses raw data). When AT+MHTTPCFG="urlencode" is enabled, the module shall automatically encode the requested <path>, excluding alphanumeric characters and the symbols such as : -_.!~*'();/?:@&=+$,#.

<local_path>The local file path, with its length range dependent on the file system. When saving the downloaded file locally, the file is opened in append mode. If the file already exists, the downloaded data will be appended to the end of the file without clearing the original content. To overwrite an existing file, delete the original file using AT+MFDELETE before starting the download.
ML302S/ML307S/ML302A/ML305A/ML307A/ML307G/ML307R/ML307B/ML307C/MR380R/MR380M: If the first character of <local_path> is a forward slash ("/"), the downloaded file will be stored in the path specified by the user; otherwise, it will be stored in the /etc/http_file/ directory.
ML305U/ML305M/ML307X/ML307Y: If <local_path> contains only a forward slash ("/"), the downloaded file will be stored at the user-specified path; If only a backslash ("\") or no slashes at all, the file will be saved under /etc/http_file/.
ML307M/ML307H/MN319-A: <local_path> parameter setting is not supported.
ML307Y: Directories occupy storage space. It is recommended to use single-level directories whenever possible.

Send GET request AT+MHTTPCREATE="http://120.27.12.119:10080" +MHTTPCREATE: 0 OK AT+MHTTPREQUEST=0,1,0,"/get" OK +MHTTPURC: "header",0,200,225,HTTP/1.1 200 OK Server: nginx/1.18.0 Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2021 09:59:35 GMT Content-Type: application/json Content-Length: 145 Connection: keep-alive Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true +MHTTPURC: "content",0,145,145,145,{"args":{},"headers":{"Connection":"close","Content-Length":"0","Host":"localhost:6000"},"origin":"127.0.0.1","url":"http://localhost:6000/get"}

sl.sli: M5310-E/MN327/MN328/MN318/MN316/MN319/MN319-A/MN326/MN316A/MN326A: the > data input mode is not supported; data must be input directly in the AT commands. Single input length is limited by platform’s single command constraints, thus, for larger data, multiple inputs are recommended. MN319/MN319-A: The maximum length of AT command parameters is 1560 bytes.
ML307B: The maximum length of AT command parameter is 3,000 bytes.

When redirection of requested response is encountered, HTTP shall redirects to HTTPS. If SSL is not enabled (<ssl_enable> and <ssl_id> parameters are omitted), the module shall automatically enable SSL and connect with default configurations.

ML307A/ML307R/ML307C: If the HTTP response header contains Connection: close, execute AT+MHTTPDEL=<id> to delete the instance after each request completes. Invoke AT+MHTTPCREATE again to establish a new connection for the next request. Alternatively, add an interval of at least 1 second between two requests to avoid sending consecutive requests within a short period.
